page.content:
Michael VIII Palaiologos ends the Latin Empire.

How Recapture of Constantinople (1261) connects

  • Faction: Latin Empire — The 1261 recapture ended the Latin Empire in the city.
  • Location: Constantinople — Michael VIII recovered the capital in 1261.

What is Recapture of Constantinople (1261)?

In 1261 Michael VIII Palaiologos recovered Constantinople from the Latin Empire, restoring a smaller Byzantine state that lasted until 1453.

Key threads lead to Latin Empire and Constantinople.
